title: How do you know that it's going to rain?
scene: 他问爸爸怎么预判下雨。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: How do you know that it's going to rain?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: The sky is getting dark and heavy with clouds.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: But why does that mean it will rain?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Because the clouds hold water, and they look heavy.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: How do you know all of this stuff?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: I have watched a lot of skies in my life.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: So the sky is like a giant puddle up there?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Sort of, yes. That's why you should bring a coat.
